_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Graczyj Wąż na {width}×{height} siatce.
Sterujesz wężem {player_id}. Prawidłowe posunęcia: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (abo w/s/a/d).
Cyl: przetrwać najdłużej abo być najdłuższym a dostać najwyższy punkt (limit tur {max_turns} tur).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} died due to invalid move.

outcome.turn_limit: Utrŏp limit - nojlepszy wynik wygrywo tie-break.
